outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a histological micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot.

Panel C contains a box plot (exempt, already shows distribution) but also a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per mouse across genotype/diameter categories, averaged over n=8-18 mice, with no individual data points overlaid.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival line plot, a plot type exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Panel E includes a blot (GTP pulldown/immunoblot) and a bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 as means with error bars, but no individual data points are shown for the n replicates.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G includes immunoblots/zymography and a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shown as means with error bars, but no individual data points are overlaid.
